exec: function dv(base,weights) { const rest = [...base].reduce((s,n,i)=>s+Number(n)*weights[i],0)%11; return rest < 2 ? 0 : 11-rest; }

function cpf() { let s; do { const base='8'+Array.from({length:8},()=>Math.floor(Math.random()*10)).join(''); s=base+dv(base,[10,9,8,7,6,5,4,3,2]); s+=dv(s,[11,10,9,8,7,6,5,4,3,2]); } while(used.has(s)); used.add(s); return s; }
